description: Full Plainly entry for one tool, model or host: summary, what it is for, open or closed, licence, whether you can sell what you make (and conditions), every plan and price, access, skill needed, maker, rights and safety (training on your work, watermarks, face/voice cloning), related entries, alternatives, and a source URL with check date for every fact. Accepts the slug (e.g. "midjourney") or a name.

slug.description: Entry slug from find_tool, or the tool's name, e.g. "suno" or "Runway".

name: get_entry
title: Get everything about one tool or model
